_what: Human-level realism: the small real behaviours of the hand holding the phone, the person in front of it, their skin and life, their senses and their place. A production brief picks from here (video spice, layer 2–4 and 7) by format; a clip or picture prompt carries the `prompt` words. Never coin an entry in a run: add it here.
_source: the owner 2026-10-20: 'it's little things like subtle selfie hand holding being slightly shaky … realistic movements, human level … it all depends on the format … build an index for this stuff in the repo'

formats.selfie-talk: one person, phone at arm's length
formats.propped-phone-talk: one person, phone propped on a stand or object
formats.counter-demo: a person making or showing something at a counter or table
formats.sit-down-interview: seated, phone on a stand facing them
formats.street-interview: an interviewer's phone held out to a stranger
formats.grwm-mirror: getting ready, often in a mirror
formats.pov-hands: the phone looking down at the person's own hands

rows.what_you_see: The frame never sits dead still: tiny, irregular shakes from a hand at arm's length.
rows.prompt: Handheld selfie at arm's length: tiny irregular hand shake, never perfectly still.
rows.source: the owner 2026-10-20: subtle selfie hand holding being slightly shaky

rows.what_you_see: A slow rise and fall in the frame in time with the holder's breathing.
rows.prompt: The handheld frame rises and falls very slightly with the holder's breathing.

rows.what_you_see: Over a long take the phone sinks a little, then gets lifted back to framing.
rows.prompt: Over the take the phone slowly sinks a little and is nudged back up into framing.

rows.what_you_see: A small, quick correction when the subject drifts out of centre.
rows.prompt: A small, quick handheld reframe when they lean out of centre.

rows.what_you_see: A step rhythm in the frame: bob and slight roll with each footstep.
rows.prompt: Walking with the phone: a gentle bob and slight roll on each footstep.

rows.what_you_see: A phone propped on a stand or against a jar: almost still, with a faint wobble when the counter is touched.
rows.prompt: Phone propped on the counter: almost still, a faint wobble when they touch the counter.

rows.what_you_see: The holder tilts down to follow what the hands are doing, a beat behind, then comes back up.
rows.prompt: The handheld phone tilts down to follow their hands a beat late, then comes back up to their face.

rows.what_you_see: When something comes close to the lens, the phone's focus breathes and catches it a moment late.
rows.prompt: The phone's autofocus hunts for a moment as the object comes close to the lens, then locks.

rows.what_you_see: Brightness shifts a touch as the phone turns toward or away from the window.
rows.prompt: The phone's exposure shifts slightly as it turns toward the window light.

rows.what_you_see: An interviewer's phone held out to a stranger: small jolts and a held-out arm's sway.
rows.prompt: Interviewer's phone held out at a stranger: small jolts and the sway of a held-out arm.

rows.what_you_see: Small, slow nods while they talk or while a point lands.
rows.prompt: Small, slow nods as the point lands.

rows.what_you_see: The side-to-side head bobble of agreement or listening.
rows.prompt: A gentle side-to-side head bobble of agreement.
rows.source: the owner 2026-10-20: the little head bobble an Indian avatar does when agreeing or listening

rows.what_you_see: A small polite nod, hands sometimes brought together near the chest.
rows.prompt: A small polite nod, hands briefly brought together near the chest.

rows.what_you_see: Two fingers tap the counter when a point is made.
rows.prompt: Two fingers tap the counter as they make the point.

rows.what_you_see: A hand comes to the chest on something sincere or personal.
rows.prompt: A hand comes to their chest on the sincere line.

rows.what_you_see: They lean toward the lens and lower their voice for the secret.
rows.prompt: They lean toward the lens, voice lowered, as if telling a secret.

rows.what_you_see: A glance to the side, remembering, before the next line.
rows.prompt: A brief glance to the side, remembering, then back to the lens.

rows.what_you_see: A small shrug on 'that's just how it is'.
rows.prompt: A small shrug on the throwaway line.

rows.what_you_see: Eyes drop to the hands while working, then come back up to the lens.
rows.prompt: Eyes drop to their hands while they work, then come back up to the lens.

rows.what_you_see: A quick lift of the eyebrows on the surprising part.
rows.prompt: A quick eyebrow lift on the surprising part.

rows.what_you_see: A knowing half-smile that starts before the line ends.
rows.prompt: A knowing half-smile that starts before the line ends.

rows.what_you_see: Lips pressed together, a small disapproving pause before the problem.
rows.prompt: Lips pressed together in a small disapproving pause.

rows.what_you_see: The nose wrinkles at something gross.
rows.prompt: Their nose wrinkles slightly at the gross part.

rows.what_you_see: Blinks at an irregular human rhythm, never a stare.
rows.prompt: They blink naturally at an irregular rhythm.

rows.what_you_see: A slight squint toward bright window light.
rows.prompt: A slight squint toward the bright window.

rows.what_you_see: Real skin: pores, fine lines, age spots, uneven tone; no smoothing.
rows.prompt: Real skin with pores, fine lines, age spots and uneven tone; no beauty filter.

rows.what_you_see: Marks of a life's work on the hands: stained fingertips, small scars, calluses.
rows.prompt: Their hands carry the marks of their work (from the profile's life marks).
rows.source: the owner 2026-10-20: Grandma Yai's fingers slightly yellow from the turmeric

rows.what_you_see: The things they use are worn from years of use: a chipped bowl, a smooth wooden spoon, rubbed-down bangles.
rows.prompt: The things they use are worn from years of use.

rows.what_you_see: They bring the ingredient to the nose and breathe it in.
rows.prompt: They bring it to their nose and breathe it in.

rows.what_you_see: They rub the paste or the cloth between fingertip and thumb.
rows.prompt: They rub it between fingertip and thumb to feel the texture.

rows.what_you_see: They hold the result up and look at it closely before showing it.
rows.prompt: They hold it up and look at it closely before turning it to the lens.

rows.what_you_see: A little steam from a warm bowl, dust in the window light.
rows.prompt: A little steam from the warm bowl; dust visible in the window light.

rows.what_you_see: Something small moves in the background: a curtain, a leaf, light through a window.
rows.prompt: Small natural movement in the background: a curtain or leaves outside the window.

rows.what_you_see: The faint grain and compression of a phone video, not a clean render.
rows.prompt: Edit: add the light grain and compression of a phone recording.

rows.what_you_see: The frame sits a degree or two off level, the way a hand holds a phone.
rows.prompt: Edit: rotate the frame a degree or two off level, varying slowly.

rows.what_you_see: A clip that came out too still gets a hand's tiny shake added.
rows.prompt: Edit: a tiny irregular shake on a clip that came out too still.

rows.what_you_see: Captions look exactly like the app's own caption style (font, motion, glow).
rows.prompt: Edit: the caption look of the app the piece pretends to be made in (looks/bank.json).
rows.source: the owner 2026-10-20: it can never look like it's being edited off of the phone

rows.what_you_see: A pinch-zoom that overshoots slightly and settles, the way a thumb does it.
rows.prompt: Edit: a pinch-zoom that overshoots a touch and settles back.

rows.what_you_see: A small audible breath before a line starts.
rows.prompt: Voice: a small natural breath before the line.

rows.what_you_see: The voice speeds up on the exciting part and slows on the secret.
rows.prompt: Voice: speeds up a little on the exciting part, slows on the secret.

stages.writing: the production brief decides it: which beat, which line, which shot
stages.production: the picture or the clip carries it (its prompt words)
